name: scope-gate-v1
declared: 2026-10-08, before the gate was written or run
purpose: Offline: replace the failed prompt-notice control (flagged-answer-v1) with a deterministic gate outside the model. Scope-detector v2 runs on the passages an answer cites; the gate then rewrites the answer by fixed template. No model call, no cost, no holdout.

gate.some_flagged: claims citing a flagged passage are kept with their citations and quotes but their text is prefixed 'Only if this applies to you (<qualifiers>): '. Unflagged claims unchanged. Status 'answered' becomes 'partial'. One missing_information line is appended asking for the unestablished qualifier(s).
gate.all_flagged: no claims. Status needs_clarification. missing_information holds one template sentence naming the unestablished qualifiers and asking which reason code or program applies. The withheld claims are written to an audit record, not shown.
gate.no_generated_text: all new wording comes from fixed templates filled with detector qualifiers

inputs: The 40 citation-valid saved baseline answers, the E13 and E22 baseline answers (inside the 40), and the E22 flagged-answer-v1 attempt (4 claims citing S020, S002, S015). Development bundle only.

thresholds.G1: After gating, no claim that cites a flagged passage lacks the 'Only if this applies to you' prefix, for every input (checked mechanically)
thresholds.G2: Gate changes exactly 2 of the 40 baseline answers (E13, E22); the other 38 are returned byte-identical
thresholds.G3: E13 baseline keeps at least 1 unconditional claim and conditionalises exactly the claims citing S002/S019; E22 baseline and the E22 flagged-answer-v1 attempt both become needs_clarification with no claims
thresholds.G4: Every gated output passes validate_answer against its frozen pack with quotes unchanged
thresholds.G5: Two runs produce identical output hashes
thresholds.G6: Report information withheld: number of claims and words moved behind a conditional or withheld, per changed answer

decision_rule: Pass only if G1 to G5 hold. G6 is reported, not thresholded. A pass shows the gate is safe and cheap on development data, not that it generalises: detector recall on unseen packs is what the holdout will test.
limits: Tuned on E13 and E22, the cases that defined the detector
Gate is only as good as detector recall; an unflagged wrong-scope claim passes through
Conditional prefix is a template, so wording can be clumsy
Failing closed withholds the whole E22 answer until scope is supplied; accepted trade-off from flagged-answer-behaviour.md
Does not address exception binding (E23) or completeness
Advisory prototype, not wired into generation
